summary.tldr: Changes the Citizenship Act to expand citizenship by descent, update rules for adopted children, restore some lost citizenship, and add a simpler renunciation process.
what_it_does: Ensures people born outside Canada before this bill takes effect to a Canadian parent can get citizenship by descent.
Grants citizenship by descent to some people born outside Canada after the first generation if their Canadian parent had a substantial connection to Canada before the birth.
Allows citizenship to be granted to people born outside Canada who were adopted by a Canadian parent before this bill takes effect.
Allows citizenship to be granted to people born outside Canada who are adopted after this bill takes effect, if their Canadian parent had a substantial connection to Canada before the adoption.

Restores citizenship to some people who lost it because they did not apply to keep it, or because their retention application was not approved, and gives some new citizens a simpler way to renounce citizenship.
